statement.zh: 教科文与学术综合将库斯科与马丘比丘表述为印加（Tawantinsuyu）晚期帝国高地建筑与政治中心的代表（UNESCO 273、274；D'Altroy 2014）。
statement.en: UNESCO and scholarly syntheses frame Cusco and Machu Picchu as representative highland architectural and political centres of the late Inca (Tawantinsuyu) empire (UNESCO 273, 274; D'Altroy 2014).
